# Feature: Meshy generating health + monotonic progress

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-18 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
While Meshy generates an avatar, the preview overlay must not glitch via progress going backwards (99→90), must communicate long “rigging/download” waits clearly, and must show whether the poll connection is healthy so users can tell waiting apart from a hung client.

## Preconditions
- Character Editor, Avatar-Quelle “Mit KI erstellen”, job in queued/generating/rigging.
- Overlay already mounts via `onJobChange`.

## Happy Path
- [ ] Displayed progress is monotonic (never decreases while the same job runs).
- [ ] At `rigging`, label says download/save wording (not “Charakter wird erzeugt”).
- [ ] Overlay shows connection health: healthy after successful poll; degraded/stale if polls fail or go quiet beyond threshold.
- [ ] Successful poll updates “last seen” without layout jump of the progress % digits (tabular-nums kept).

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Poll network errors: health → unhealthy/stale; overlay stays; polling continues.
- [ ] Job success/fail: overlay unmounts; health cleared.
- [ ] Progress from server lower than displayed: keep higher display value until job ends.

## Regression
- [ ] Provider dropdown / prompt counter unchanged.
- [ ] AvatarSurfaceViewer outside editor unchanged.

## Assumptions
- Health is client-side (last successful `pollMeshyAvatarJob`); no new edge fields.
- Stale threshold ~8s (≈3 missed 2.5s polls).

## Security Coverage
- No secrets in UI; health is boolean/timestamp only.
- Backend B-xx out of scope (UI-only).

## Composition Gate
- Producer: panel poll success/fail → health + job snapshot.
- Consumer: overlay (display only).
- Invalid/missing: no overlay / health idle.
